subject.statement: Do Kwon is currently in custody in Podgorica, Montenegro as of October 2026.

summary: As of 2026-10-01, Do Kwon is not in custody in Podgorica, Montenegro; he was extradited to the United States in late 2024/early 2025 and is serving a 15‑year federal prison sentence there.

findings.statement: Do Kwon was extradited from Montenegro to the United States after serving about 17 months in Montenegrin jail, as reported by AP News.
As of early 2026, Do Kwon is serving a 15‑year federal prison sentence in the United States after being sentenced in December 2025, with credit for time served in Montenegro.
The Montenegrin Ministry of Justice approved Do Kwon's extradition in December 2024.
